name: joel-plugins
description: A collection of plugins useful for development tasks

plugins.name: tts-output
plugins.description: Text-to-speech output for Claude responses using macOS 'say' command with customizable voice, speed, and AI-generated summaries

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Interactive interview command that asks in-depth questions to gather detailed requirements and generate comprehensive specifications

plugins.name: elysia-specialist
plugins.description: ElysiaJS specialist plugin that provides advanced code analysis, debugging, and documentation lookup capabilities for ElysiaJS applications

plugins.name: setup-isolated-env
plugins.description: One-time setup plugin for creating automation scripts for isolated development environments using git worktrees. Guides projects through establishing parallel feature development infrastructure with separate worktrees, unique ports, isolated databases, and independent environment configurations.
